entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Bloch MB.300 Pacifique was a French all-metal three-engine monoplane that was developed as an airliner for Air France. A single prototype was produced by Société des Avions Marcel Bloch in 1935, and was eventually rejected by Air France in 1938 in favour of the Dewoitine D.620.
